claim_scope: DigiRef project data model
notes: DigiRef states that 118 archivalia were selected for the Visitationsprotokolle research module; its working definition of protocol is systematic capture of information about parish places; Beiakten, accounts and inventories were mostly excluded; page search hits are normally entry points into larger place blocks.

claim_scope: DigiRef object-type distinction
notes: Portal distinguishes Akten, Seiten, Schaufensterdokumente and Visitationsprotokolle; the categories must not be collapsed.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 3 whole archival unit
notes: Official title Visitation in Jena, Neustadt (Orla), Pößneck, Saalfeld (Saale); dating 1529; 525 leaves; contains Neustadt 41r-63v, Pfarreinkommen Ziegenrück 297v-302v, Pfarreinkommen Gössitz/Knau etc. 303r-306r and Rezesse der Visitatoren 1529 508r-523r.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 4 Bd. I and II whole archival units
notes: Both units are titled Visitation in Thüringen and dated 1533 [1534 - 1536]; 4/1 has 364 leaves and 4/2 has 418 leaves. Reg. Ii 4/2 contains Visitation im Amt Ziegenrück at 294r-313r.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 5 whole archival unit
notes: Official title Registratur für die Superintendentur Neustadt (Orla) (Auszug); dating [1533 - 1536]; 94 leaves; contains Neustadt, Arnshaugk, Leuchtenburg/Ziegenrück, Ziegenrück 55v-66v, Ranis, Roda/Jüdewein and ordering/report material.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 6 later second-visitation context
notes: Official title Visitation in Altenburg, Remse, Borna und Colditz; dating 1533-1535; contents explicitly include second visitations in several places.

claim_scope: Earlier Neustadt visitation activity in 1527
notes: Visitation in Weida, Neustadt (Orla), Saalfeld (Saale) und Pößneck, dated 1527; Neustadt group at 23r-28r. This prevents treating 1529 as the first ever visitation activity in Neustadt without qualification.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 3 Neustadt bounded source group
locator: Visitation in Neustadt an der Orla, 41r-63v
notes: User-supplied DigiRef snapshot gives visitation period 23.5.-1.6.1529 and notes arrival on 23 May, surrounding-community visitation from 24 May and departure toward Pößneck on 1 June. Public official finding aid independently confirms the 41r-63v placement in Reg. Ii 3.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 3 Gössitz/Knau income bounded source group
locator: Pfarreinkommen Gössitz, Knau (mit Laskau, Bahren), Liebschütz (mit Liebengrün), 303r-306r
notes: User-supplied DigiRef snapshot gives title and folio extent but no separate visitation period. Exact local date must therefore not be manufactured from the parent unit date.

claim_scope: Ziegenrück in 1529 recess context
notes: DigiRef indexes Ziegenrück in the 1529 recess material of Reg. Ii 3; official finding aid places the recess group at 508r-523r.

claim_scope: 1533 sequencing of Thüringen visitation around Jena/Neustadt
notes: The visitors ask whether, after completion of the Jena circuit, the Neustadt visitation should be postponed until after hay harvest. This proves 1533 administrative sequencing but not an exact Ziegenrück visit day.

claim_scope: Ziegenrück administrative matter in 1533 visitation context
notes: Instruction concerning restoration of land to Drognitz and also the Ziegenrück pastor and four acres of wood, dated 1533.

claim_scope: Ziegenrück correspondence with Thüringen visitators in 1533
notes: Correspondence between Elector Johann Friedrich and the appointed Thüringen visitators concerning a vicarage of Johann Rost at Ziegenrück, dated 1533.

claim_scope: Personnel of the 1533 Thüringen visitation
notes: Official descriptions name Justus Menius, Friedrich Myconius, Georg von Wangenheim, Georg von Denstedt and Eisenach mayor Johann Kothe as the appointed Thüringen visitators. Johann Friedrich appears as sovereign/issuing authority in related records and should not be flattened into the visitor list.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 4/5 Knau textual relationship
notes: Completed project collation #99: selective/condensed textual correspondence with substantial shared decree sequence, omissions and resegmentation; no line-for-line identity, no same-hand claim and no Reg. Ii 4 diplomatic correction.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 5 as extract relation for Ziegenrück bounded group
notes: Provider/archival metadata states the Reg. Ii 5 Ziegenrück group is an extract from the corresponding Reg. Ii 4 Bd. II material. This catalogue relation is distinct from the independently observed textual relation.

claim_scope: Second visitation wave in 1533; 3 March belongs to Creuzburg in published chronology
locator: Julia Beez, Lokale Reformationsjubiläen in Thüringen, table of first visitation dates
notes: Modern scholarship describes a first broad wave in 1528/29 and a second in 1533. The published table underlying the discussion assigns 03.03.1533 to Creuzburg, not Ziegenrück. This is a warning against recycling 3 March as a local Ziegenrück date; it is not itself the primary basis for dating our source group.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 3 Neustadt group includes Ziegenrück among indexed places
locator: Visitation in Neustadt an der Orla, page 50v
notes: DigiRef search results index Ziegenrück in the 1529 Neustadt visitation source group; this is place-index evidence, not a claim that the entire source group concerns Ziegenrück.

claim_scope: Reg. Ii 4/5 serial parallel beyond Knau
locator: Leuchtenburg/Ziegenrück place blocks in Reg. Ii 4 Bd. II and Reg. Ii 5
notes: Portal search results show corresponding place blocks in Reg. Ii 4 Bd. II and Reg. Ii 5 beyond Knau, supporting the interpretation of Reg. Ii 5 as a broader selective parallel/extract structure. Full-document textual derivation is not inferred from index parallelism alone.

claim_scope: DigiRef search semantics
notes: DigiRef states that a search normally targets the first page where a place is named and that this entry point often begins a larger page sequence. A portal hit therefore cannot be treated as a documentary boundary without separate evidence.
